item.researchenchanting.research_focus.e: Nothing researched yet. Place it in an enchanting table to open its research tree.
item.researchenchanting.research_focus.s: Shelve it in a chiseled bookshelf near an enchanting table to enchant with it.
item.researchenchanting.research_notes.u: Put it in a container next to an enchanting table while this enchantment is being researched (this level or lower): it pays for the whole level.
enchantment.researchenchanting.rending.d: Each hit strips 2, 3 or 4 armour points from the target for 6 seconds, stacking up to 3 hits.
Sneak and use to fire a grapple that pulls you to the block you aim at (10, 16 or 22 blocks). 4 second cooldown, no fall damage after.
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc: 5, 10 or 15% chance a hit calls lightning down on the target. 8 second cooldown. The lightning never sets blocks alight.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Killing a mob summons 1, 2 or 3 silverfish that fight monsters for you for 20 seconds, then crumble.
gui.researchenchanting.open_tree_tip: Open this focus's research tree. A book holds one enchantment: researching another line replaces it.
gui.researchenchanting.feed: Needs %s more %s from a chest, barrel or vault within 3 blocks of the table.
gui.researchenchanting.nothing_offered: No researched focus on the chiseled bookshelves around the table offers anything for this item.
gui.researchenchanting.lower: Right-click to pick a lower level
gui.researchenchanting.hint_empty: Place a plain book to bind it, a focus book to research it, or any item to enchant it.
gui.researchenchanting.node.feed: Put the resource in a chest, barrel or vault within 3 blocks of the table.
gui.researchenchanting.node.busy: Finish the research already paid into first
emi.info.researchenchanting.table1: Put a plain book and lapis in an enchanting table and play Echo (repeat the order the buttons light up) to bind it into a random Research Focus.
emi.info.researchenchanting.table2: Put the focus back in the table and pick a level in its research tree. The table pulls that level's resource from chests, barrels or vaults within 3 blocks (one level below the table up to one above). A book holds one enchantment.
emi.info.researchenchanting.table3: Shelve researched foci in chiseled bookshelves around the table (up to 3 blocks out, at the table's level or one up, with clear blocks between). Plain bookshelves do nothing.
emi.info.researchenchanting.table4: Put any item in the table to enchant it with what the shelved foci know: XP levels for the levels added, plus 1 lapis. Books are never used up.
emi.info.researchenchanting.notes: Enchanted books from loot and trades become Research Notes. Feed one to the table while researching its enchantment (that level or lower) to finish the level at once.
item.researchenchanting.research_focus.u: Put a plain book and lapis in an enchanting table to bind one.
item.researchenchanting.book_hint: Put in an enchanting table with lapis to bind it into a Research Focus.
gui.researchenchanting.hint_no_books: No focus books on nearby chiseled shelves offer anything for this. Bind a plain book here to start one.
gui.researchenchanting.echo_rules: The buttons light up in an order. Repeat it. Each round is one step longer; a wrong press costs a lapis and plays the round again.
gui.researchenchanting.echo_cost: %s XP levels when the book is bound
emi.researchenchanting.bind_how: Repeat the order the buttons light
message.researchenchanting.busy: The table is enchanting. Wait for it to finish.
